scope: Leased Android cohorts running the experimental compiler-proved whole-root Element Template backend in official Lynx Explorer 4.1.0. The earlier samples prove the recorded safety boundary; the exact-head follow-up compares one 1,000-row create cell with 10 AB/BA pairs. Neither is a general Android, iOS, memory, list, no-JIT, cross-framework, or default-switch claim.

runner.adapterModification: The table-action measurement disables DevTool DOM events around the native tap and timing-marker wait, then restores them. This prevents observer backpressure from dominating a 10,000-row mutation; startup samples do not use that measured-tap suppression.
runner.deviceIdentity: redacted; immutable result names retain only the runner's hashed cohort identity

candidate.configuration: production automatic Block core plus experimental whole-root Element Template backend

startup30000FailClosed.interpretation: The eager 30,000-row table exceeds the resident native-node budget and is rejected before Android's weak-global-reference table. A virtualized native list is the supported architecture for this scale.

exactHeadCreate1000Comparison.protocol: octane-issue194-device-v1 with lynx-native-bench-v2 and octane-issue194-compact-main-v1 receipts
exactHeadCreate1000Comparison.interpretation: The complete structural Element Template configuration won this exact-head create cell at both boundaries while retaining exact semantic state. App-bundle engine 3.2 versus ordinary 3.9 is an inherent configuration difference, frame bytes were effectively unchanged, and the larger shipping bundle is a recorded cost.

rejectedCandidates.finding: A synchronous first-screen plan-node limit of 40,960 was unsafe because one template node can enqueue multiple PaintingContext callbacks inside renderPage's coalesced flush scope.
rejectedCandidates.observed: PaintingContext global-reference overflow and Explorer process death
rejectedCandidates.resolution: Use the independently qualified 8,192 single-batch budget for synchronous first-screen admission and defer larger trees intact to the background store.

rejectedCandidates.finding: Draining queued PaintingContext work alone did not bound live shadow-node ownership.
rejectedCandidates.observed: TextShadowNode weak-global-reference overflow and Explorer process death
rejectedCandidates.resolution: Track compiler-proved resident native-node cost separately and reject above 40,960 before native creation.
